CALL TO ORDER
Chair Doplemore called the meeting to order at 5:02 p.m.
ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Goodin, Osborn, Doplemore, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Schotter

Commissioners Absent: Hill

Also present: Erica Valencia­Adachi, Collective Impact Manager, Gina Overholt,
Coordinator.
Also in attendance: Josh “Smitty” Smith, Christina Boatwright, Resource Connections
Supervisor, and Melanie Martins, LCSW with the VA Long Beach.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
Commissioner James Schotter led the Pledge of Allegiance. Following the pledge, the
Commission Chair provided a brief report, and asked to re­order the agenda to
accommodate the guest speaker. Commission staff provided a brief report.
Commissioners were reminded that public comment on non­agendized items takes place
at the top of the meeting, and public comment also takes place after each agendized item,
with a three­minute limit per commenter. (The vice chair will keep time).The meeting needs
to end by 6:50 because the building closes at 7 p.m. Staff welcomed Melanie Martins and
acknowledged the successful Stand Down, which took place earlier that day in Veterans
Park, as well as a successful Lone Sailor 20th anniversary, on Sunday, October 12. A new
CD 8 Commissioner will be presented to Council on October 22.

3. 24­55273 Recommendation to discuss Goal 4 of the Veterans Strategic Plan.

  Goal 4 of the Veterans Strategic Plan states, “Veterans who are precariously housed
  or who are experiencing homelessness have access to affordable housing and the
  supportive services they need to remain housing.” Because of the income they they
  receive as service­connected Veterans, Veterans in­need were ineligible for certain
  housing programs and services. Fair Housing Act bills (passed in 2022) benefit
  Veterans by no longer including this income. With this motion, the Commission a
  subcommittee to proceed with exploring ways to educate the public (especially
  landlords and developers) about this and to advocate for Veterans with housing needs.
  Commissioners Doplemore, Schotter, and Atkins­Blade will participate.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Atkins Blade, seconded by
  Commissioner Sramek, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by
  the following vote:
  Yes:  6 Goodin, Osborn, Doplemore, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Schotter
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Hill

  Commissioner Schotter shared photos of Veterans graves in the City’s cemeteries on
  Willow Street that are in need of cleaning. Discussion followed. Mr. Schotter will
  explore the details involved with a future cleaning project; this item will be again be
  agendized at a future meeting.
5. 24­55275 Recommendation to discuss the Veterans banners program.

  This motion re­established the Veterans Banners program as a subcommittee. The
  Commission discussed the renewal of the Veterans Banners program for FY 2025.
  During public comment, former Commissioner Josh “Smitty” Smith, who chaired the
  ad hoc subcommittee in FY 2024, advised the Commission on lessons learned and
  that it is time begin the process. Vice Chair Olson will chair the banners
  subcommittee.
  A motion was made by Commissioner Atkins Blade, seconded by
  Commissioner Goodin, to approve recommendation. The motion by the
  following vote:
  Yes:  6 Goodin, Osborn, Doplemore, Sramek, Atkins Blade, Schotter
  No:  0 None
  Recused: 0 None
  Abstain: 0 None
  Absent: 1 Hill
6. 24­55276 Recommendation to discuss Beach Streets/Veterans Day Celebration.

  Staff presented on Veterans Day, starting with the slideshow she presented at Council
  on 10/15. Because Veterans Day is a hub at Beach Streets Uptown, it is essential to
  communicate to the Veterans community at the public at­large that the celebration is
  accessible, with ADA parking and a Paratransit drop off on Harding street. Staff asked
  the Commission’s to assist with promoting the event by distributing postcards and
  posting on social media, and assisting with the Veterans Resources Fair and other
  tasks related to making Veterans Day successful. Two online Veterans Day planning
  conversations were set for October 18 and October 25.
